description: Marathon runner does a correct easy Zone 2 run. Dean should affirm the effort, connect it to marathon prep, and NOT lecture about keeping easy runs easy or add caveats.

ground_truth.notes: Sarah ran 6mi at 9:35/mi with avg HR 138. Her easy pace is 9:30/mi (±20s = 9:10–9:50/mi). HR 138 on an estimated max of ~182 = 75.8% — solidly Zone 2 / aerobic zone. The insight MUST positively affirm she ran easy correctly — e.g. 'HR sat right in Zone 2 — exactly the aerobic stimulus marathon training needs.' It should then connect to marathon prep. It MUST NOT say 'remember to keep easy runs easy' or any variant — she already did it right. It MUST NOT say her pace was slow or add caveats. The pace 9:35 is appropriate for her easy pace. Affirm, connect to goal, done.
forbidden_phrases: make sure to keep it easy
try to keep the pace easy
